settings.title: Desktop settings
settings.autoStartDescription: Start Sharkord automatically when you log in to your computer.
settings.startToTrayDescription: Open in the background when the app starts, without showing the window. Open it again from the tray icon.
settings.connectAllOnStartup: Connect to all servers on startup
settings.connectAllOnStartupDescription: Load every server in the background when the app opens, so you get unread counts and notifications from all of them. Uses more memory.
settings.throttleHiddenServersDescription: Slow down timers and rendering of servers you are not looking at. Saves CPU and battery, turn it off if background servers misbehave.
settings.performanceOverlayDescription: Show memory and CPU usage of the app in a small window.
settings.menuBarDescription: Show or hide the window menu bar. You can also use Ctrl+Shift+M.
settings.shortcutsDescription: Shortcuts that work anywhere in the desktop app.

shortcut.toggleServerList: Show or hide the server list
shortcut.toggleMenuBar: Show or hide the menu bar
